## Checklist

- [ ] The project is **functional** — it produces, parses, or integrates with Cooklang.
- [ ] The project has a **README** explaining what it does and how to use it.
- [ ] The project is **maintained** (commits in the last 18 months) **or** has a tagged release that still works.
- [ ] The link is to a **public** repo, package, or URL — no private / paid-only access.
- [ ] The entry is **distinct** from existing entries, or the differentiator is explained below.
- [ ] The entry follows the format: `- [Name](url) — One-line description. Optional language / platform note.`
- [ ] Description starts with a capital letter and ends with a period.
- [ ] If this is a recipe collection (a cookbook written in Cooklang), I'm submitting it to [awesome-cooklang-recipes](https://github.com/cooklang/awesome-cooklang-recipes) instead.
